name: 488. A vendor query parameter sent more than once on GET /v1/models and GET /v1/files is refused, never reduced to one value (repeated vendor query) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7086 regression. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. GET /v1/models and GET /v1/files forward the query parameters the gateway does not read to the provider. They kept one value of a name sent more than once, so endpoint=chat&endpoint=embed listed Cohere's chat models as if embed had never been sent. Now every value reaches the provider code, and a provider whose vendor takes the parameter once refuses the request with 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming it, before any vendor call. The pp_cohere rows (base_url is the fixture) read /__wire: no call for the repeated endpoint, one call carrying endpoint once. The bedrock rows are refused before a request is built, so they need no upstream; Bedrock ignores base_url and is not pointed at the fixture for them. Run the whole folder in order.

item.name: pp_cohere GET /v1/models with endpoint sent twice: 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming endpoint, no vendor call (repeated vendor query) [EXPECT-400]

exec: pm.test('repeated vendor query setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.test('the client gets 400', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, text).to.equal(400); });
pm.test('the body is JSON', function () { body = pm.response.json(); });
pm.test('error.param names endpoint', function () { pm.expect((body.error || {}).param, text).to.equal('endpoint'); });
// wire: nothing reached the fixture, the request was refused before any vendor call.
pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('no upstream call', function () { pm.expect(res.json().data[0].calls, res.text()).to.have.length(0); });

item.name: pp_cohere GET /v1/models with endpoint sent once: the vendor receives it (repeated vendor query)

exec: pm.test('repeated vendor query setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, text).to.equal(200); });
// wire: the request that reached the fixture, with the query string as it arrived.
pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('exactly one upstream call', function () { pm.expect(calls, res.text()).to.have.length(1); });
pm.test('the vendor received endpoint once, and provider is not forwarded', function () { pm.expect((calls[0] || {}).query, res.text()).to.equal('?endpoint=chat&page_size=1000'); });
